name: AI Design Skills
summary: A growing collection of design skills for AI coding tools; the first is a landing-page system with structure and visual rules.
description: A collection of self-contained design skill folders for AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Windsurf. The landing-page-design skill covers intake questions, page structure, layout selection, conversion rules, copywriting, build order and SEO/AEO, plus strict visual rules for typography, spacing, corner radius, borders and backgrounds, hero sections, icons and motion. Design values sit in one editable section of each SKILL.md; MIT licensed.
